roles/wiz.cloudInventoryViewer.title: Wiz Cloud Inventory Viewer
roles/wiz.cloudInventoryViewer.desc: Provides broad read-only access to discover, list, and read resource metadata and configuration across Google Cloud. Intended for automated cloud asset discovery and inventory, configuration analysis, and building a unified security view of cloud infrastructure.

roles/wiz.dataSecurityScanner.title: Wiz Data Security Manager
roles/wiz.dataSecurityScanner.desc: Provides access to manage dedicated inventory buckets, configure Storage Insights reporting, and trigger security scans across cloud databases and storage systems. Intended for orchestrating automated data discovery and data classification campaigns.

roles/wiz.forensicsResponder.title: Wiz Forensics Responder
roles/wiz.forensicsResponder.desc: Provides administrative capabilities to create, label, analyze, and safely delete Compute Engine snapshots.

roles/wiz.serverlessImageRegistryScanner.title: Wiz Serverless & Container Image Registry Scanner
roles/wiz.serverlessImageRegistryScanner.desc: Provides read and download access to Artifact Registry repositories, Cloud Storage objects, Cloud Run revisions, and Cloud Functions source code to scan serverless and container workloads.

roles/wiz.workloadScanner.title: Wiz Workload Scanner
roles/wiz.workloadScanner.desc: Provides read-only access to disks, images, and snapshots for agentless workload scanning. Intended for automated vulnerability management, malware detection, and secrets scanning.
